name: Distracting Dermis
body:
Your can manipulate your swarm body with dexterity to make it writhe and wriggle, and can be used to distract your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, mannequin

Benefit(s): As a standard action a mannequin can cause any living creature that occupies an area that he threatens to become nauseated. A Fortitude save with a DC of 10 + ½ the mannequin’s hit dice (minimum 1) + the mannequin’s Constitution modifier negates this effect. Creatures who succeed on their saves must make a Concentration check (DC 20 + spell level) when casting a spell or concentrating on a spell, failure means the spell is lost. Using skills requiring patience and concentration within the areas threatened by the mannequin require a DC 15 Will save. A mannequin with this feat can perform this action a number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1).
